reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: The crowd is amazing, he prepare for placements, the faculty was average and no facilities at all.

review_content.Placements: 75% of students get placed but the average package is not so good. The highest package is around 17LPA while the lowest and average are 3-6LPA respectively. The top companies are Samsung, Josh, Optum and Acceldata. 30% of students get internships in Acceldata and Samsung. Most roles offered are Sde or Sdet.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities like Wi-Fi, Labs, Cleanliness and Maintenance of classrooms are good but the hostel facilities are not so good. The rooms are very old and the food is also not so good and tasty. There was only Football in the sports. In food, we don't have good oil and ratio is used. Even in the canteen, we have limited options and the medical facilities are good. Not many facilities sports and no support too. There are computers in labs but many do not work at all. In the library, we do not use to get every book. Disappoint but felt short of words.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied with placements and faculty members of this college.

review_content.Placements: Placements were very good. Top recruiting companies visited our college to hire students for banks, sales, and marketing roles. No company visited our college for the HR domain. Only 50% of students got placed in this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel was not available in this college. You had to find your place to stay. The girls' hostel was not available. The canteen was average in this college.
review_content.Other: Our college did not take any responsibility for your degree and mark sheet. The course was for 2 years. I would highly recommend students to take admission to it.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2016
reviews_list.review_title: This college is a good choice as HBTI is renowned. It is a top MBA college in UP.

review_content.Placements: Our college offers MBA/PGDM in different domains with dual specialisation. It is an average college in terms of placements. Top recruiting companies here were ITC, Airtel, Writer Corporation and Jaro Education. Basically, they place students in the marketing area. The remaining students struggle to find jobs on their own.
review_content.Infrastructure: STEP HBTI has an average campus, but the best part is it comes under the campus of HBTI. So, it's a nice area and very renowned in Kanpur. Now HBTI is converted into a university as HBTU, and you can join it. There are two canteens, and both of them are good. There is access to the library. Many other curricular activities are organised on the campus, and students can take part in them.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the college considering the fee.

review_content.Placements: It is a good college in terms of fees and provides MBA and PGDM courses. Around 60-70% of students got placed. The top recruiting companies are BYJU's, Extra Marks, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, OYO, ITC Limited, Indiamart, Just Dial and many more. About 95% of students do internships, and companies, which offer internships are Kotak Mahindra, ITC etc. The highest salary package offered was 7 LPA, and the lowest package was 2.5 LPA. Overall, it is a good college in terms of fees compared to other institutes.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library, computer labs, volleyball and badminton courts, Wi-Fi, etc., are available here. Hostels are not available for STEP-HBTI students. Air-conditioned classrooms are available for PGDM only, not for MBA. The infrastructure of our college is not much good, but the library and computer labs are good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: It is a good college in terms of fees.

review_content.Placements: More than 80% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered is 6 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 2.5 LPA. ICICI Bank, Byju's and Extramarks are the top recruiters for our course. About 90% of the students do internships, and companies which offer internships are ITC, etc. Many institutes also conduct pool campus drives. Our college was good compared to other institutes.
review_content.Infrastructure: Computer labs, volleyball court, library, etc., are available here. There are no hostel facilities for STEP HBTI students. There are project classrooms in which teachers teach with the presentations prepared by themselves.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: There is good placement in STEP-HBTI with highly educated faculty.

review_content.Placements: There is good placement in STEP-HBTI. The highest package of batch 2020 is around 10-12 L/annum. Companies like Just Dial, IndiaMart, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, OYO, ITC limited and other big companies visit for placements. For Internship programme, there are many companies who visit college. In my batch, almost everyone got Internship from the college itself. I will give placement 8 out of 10.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a good and big library, classrooms and canteen area. There is ground for sports activities as well. There is a computer lab for students. Well cleaned classrooms. Big cafeteria and greenery all around. There are medical facilities for all the students. I'll rate it 7 out of 10.

individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with placements and faculty members of this college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vidya College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is the finest; the classrooms we have are the finest, and the classes have ACs for the students and a class having easy gathering for 35 to 50 students. The library was also the best place in our college; all types of books are available there.

reviews.review_heading: This college has the value for money and is budget-friendly.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are very neat and clean. They provide proper food. We have very good swimming classes and gym trainers. Sports are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vidya College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very big and very airy. Students are offered lab courses every day with great facilities. There is a very big library with many books. There is a common Wi-Fi connection in college which every student can avail easily.

reviews.review_heading: Highly not recommended. Infrastructure is good but the placements are bad.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of poor quality of education, but the infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: The ground truth is that the infrastructure is shrinking day by day since the MD of the institute is changed. For the CSE department, we had a separate block previously, and with 4-5 separate labs. But now, there are only 2 computer labs in the whole department. The quality of education is very poor here. Students who come here will have their future ruined. Good and authentic faculty members in every branch are fired, and only those faculty members are left who are unskilled, and 2-3 good facul...

reviews.review_heading: Vidya College of Engineering  - average college.
reviews.review_text: I was a regular student, attended college from home so don't have any experience regarding hostel life, but on overall infra, I can say its almost better then average colleges found out in Western UP.

reviews.review_heading: Experience was good but was a little dissatisfied by less placements in mechanical department.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available good classrooms with projector and AC facilities. Medical facilities are also good, university hospital is available within the campus for any sort of emergency. Sports facilities are good. Canteen facilities are available. Campus is clean and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with all the aspects of college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was good. Hostel facilities were available from our college. All the facilities required for the course like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and library are provided.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of faculty members, but it has good placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available in our college. Classrooms are equipped with projectors and air-conditioned facility. The college provides a playground. There are many types of playgrounds like cricket, basketball, volleyball, badminton and indoor playgrounds.

reviews.review_heading: I like the faculty members; they are very supportive of everyone.
reviews.review_text: We have a separate department for our BBA and BCCA courses. We have computer labs where Excel is taught to us. The food quality available in the canteen is good. My friends and I like to sit and enjoy the food there. The chef is very good, and the food is very hygienic. Thank you.

reviews.review_heading: My experience is very good, and I have enjoyed every moment in this college.
reviews.review_text: Everything on this campus is well enough. The sports faculty is very supportive, and the canteen is also well-developed. The medical facilities are very good, with no problems at all. All facilities are very comfortable, and this college is good for development.

reviews.review_heading: Very good campus life, but no career growth.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is present only in a few selected places. Labs are there with an ample amount of equipment as well as PCs. Classrooms are small in size. The library is very well maintained and provides the books you want. Hostel facilities are not there, as nearly all students are native. Canteen food is acceptable. Good sports facilities are present.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely disappointed with the teaching and placement results.
reviews.review_text: The college has average infrastructure, like buildings, sports fields, and parking facilities, with more than enough space. The college has a well-maintained garden. No Wi-Fi is present throughout the campus. You can only get internet access in labs that are for computers through Ethernet. Classrooms, however, are very good and spacious. The library is also very well maintained, and you can get any books you want by following a few rules.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and disciplined college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was also good. The labs were hygienic and clean. The cleaning staff takes care of the rooms, labs, library, etc. The college makes everything possible. They taught us soft skills in trading in the Mahindra Pride classroom.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college but not for placements.
reviews.review_text: The college does not provide any hostel facility. But the campus was fully occupied with all the latest facilities and gadgets. The entire campus was Wi-Fi enabled and is provided to students for free facilities. There were canteen and library facilities for students.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest you do not take admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The college has a huge campus. The college provides all facilities like water and library. The campus was fully under CCTV surveillance. The college provides free Wi-Fi facility for students. The college provides free computer access at any time during college hours.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college, but the only problem with the college is the placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a high-class infrastructure. All the facilities provided in our college are excellent. The campus includes a free Wi-Fi facility. There was a library that includes more than 3,000 books are available for students of all the classes. The entire campus is under camera supervision.

reviews.review_heading: A good dicipined college
reviews.review_text:
The course was very best and teaching staff was also too good. Wifi connection of the college was excellent  .labs were hygenic,clean ,canteen facilities were also good.
Department of our courses always keep maintain the labs ,library ,classrooms.....

reviews.review_heading: It is a prime college for studying.
reviews.review_text: The college was modern. We got all the facilities we needed to study well. There was a big library, which was very helpful. There were computer labs. I was a day scholar. There was a canteen to provide food.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good and place in mid of the city, and staff also great and serve knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college was good and greenery. Library was huge up to 100 students studying at a time, and auditorium was also big with the latest equipment. Wi-Fi was available but students can only use 50 MB of data after that students can not use that. Classrooms were decent and smart classes were also available. CS laboratories were the best with air-conditioner and good infrastructure. The canteen was also decent, students can enjoy all types of snacks like poha, upmma, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I don't recommend this college to any student.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is great, and it is a huge campus. Our college provides free Wi-Fi facilities for students, and students can easily access the internet at any time. Our college also provides library and canteen facilities for all the students.

reviews.review_heading: It is good college which provides good learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very nice. It has a huge campus that includes all the major facilities for the college. The entire college has free Wi-Fi facilities. All the students can get access to the free Wi-Fi facilities. The college has also got canteen facilities .

reviews.review_heading: Never ever take admission in this college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The classes are conducted rarely. The class timing is from 3pm to 8 pm in the evening. And that is the reason most students can not attend college as it will be too late to reach their home for the students who live far from the town. The teachers are qualified but rarely teaches.

reviews.review_heading: College is worse for management studies.
reviews.review_text: The college provide all basic facilities that includes pure water supply, library that includes almost 3000 books which can be accessed by any of the students of the college. The college campus has free Wi-Fi facilities and provide computer labs with internet access.

reviews.review_heading: Average infrastructure, good faculty and the same old tier 3 placement records.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms and library are pretty nice. Labs are well equipped. Classrooms are spacious with all classes having functioning lights and fans. Some are air conditioned not all. I am not a big fan of the female washrooms. The college is in a bad location and so it is always water logged and there. Too much convenience while traveling.

reviews.review_heading: The college needs to focus on the betterment of placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The best among the infrastructure of this college is the labs and library, which are well-equipped with resources. Other than that, the campus is well organised but very small. College has a center of a bit of greenery in the garden and a small fountain. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors.

reviews.review_heading: I am very much convinced after choosing this college.
reviews.review_text: The labs and the class are bigger in size. Teachers are well qualified and have a great hands-on experience of teaching in a professional manner. There is no college hostel, you will have to search for a PG or a mess near the college, or a flat that you have to take.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is not too big. The college has a well-equipped lab with all the facilities, such as modern instruments. The Wi-Fi connectivity has high-speed internet. Classrooms have AC. The college has a cafeteria and a canteen. There is a badminton court where students can play in their free time.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are also well-maintained and provide a comfortable environment for students. Hostels have spacious rooms, hygienic mess facilities, recreation areas, reading rooms, and 24/7 security. The campus provide facilities like Wi-Fi connectivity.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, faculty members are good and friendly. Infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: It's small yet facilities are provided as per need. There are rooms with AC for CSE and all such core department, and there are also grounds for sports, badminton court, and table tennis. There are no hostel. People are supposed to get PG nearby or maybe a flat.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and campus life, average faculty, and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The B.Teach department had well-maintained classrooms with projectors, high-speed Wi-Fi, and fully equipped labs for each specialisation. The library was spacious with a good collection of technical books and journals, and Hostel facilities were decent.

reviews.review_heading: Playground is green. The Guards are supportive.
reviews.review_text: Library is well maintained, the classrooms are good, there is a high speed Wi-Fi network, the infrastructure of the buildings is amazing, the facilities are all good, we understand their teaching well, the co workers are also sober mind and helpful, and the canteen provides us with good food.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, satisfied with all.
reviews.review_text: College has all the facilities like Wi-Fi, library, labs, and also has a good infrastructure. It does not have a hostel, but it has a canteen, and the food in the canteen is good, according to the price. College also has medical facilities. It has sports facilities, and some sports competitions are conducted at certain times.

reviews.review_heading: Netaji Subhash Engineering College review.
reviews.review_text: College size is very small, and during the monsoon, some labs get inoperable. There is no proper lab for new branches such as AIML, but they are working on it, for sports, you will get a badminton court, 1 cricket field, 1 volleyball court, 1 gym, and 1 canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, lab facilities, and good placement in 2023.
reviews.review_text: We have 5 sections in our department with 70+ students each. The intake is very good. Lab is quite good with all the facilities and centralized Wi-Fi. College has 2 hostels, both for boys and girls, but they are 2 minutes walking distance away from the college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a decent value for money college with good facilities and placements.
reviews.review_text: The department has modern computer labs, high speed Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, seminar halls, and a well stocked library. AI/this labs are updated with the latest configurations required for machine learning and AI projects. The hostel facilities are decent with spacious rooms, study areas, and 24/7 Wi-Fi. The mess food is average but hygienic, and canteen options are available. Medical facilities and sports grounds for cricket, football, and indoor games are provided. Overall, the infrastructure ...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive faculty, and active campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our department has modern classrooms, Wi-Fi enabled campus, well equipped computer labs, digital library access, and project labs. The infrastructure is updated regularly to match industry standards. The hostel facilities are good, with decent Wi-Fi, medical facilities, sports grounds, and common areas. The mess food is average, though the canteen offers better options. Sports facilities include a cricket ground, a badminton court, and a gym, which make campus life active.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college because the return on investment is good.
reviews.review_text: A Wi-Fi-enabled campus, digital classroom, and central library are available here. Laboratory infrastructure is also good, a canteen is also available here, there are multiple coding and sports clubs, and many more clubs are available here, overall infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges to pursue your passion in engineering in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good enough, and students can make the most out of their college life. The labs and classes are well-maintained, and all the facilities provided are up to the mark, including sports, canteen, and games.

college_info.intro:
Shree Om University Roorkee has two popular programmes: MBA and BAMS. MBA is available in various specialisations such as Marketing, Human Resources, and Finance. The core subjects aim at developing the knowledge and required skills in the fundamental Management discipline with specialisations in the functional areas. MBA students can become Managers, Team Leaders, or can go for various other job profiles.
Shree Om University BAMS is a graduate degree programme in the Ayurvedic system. This degree is largely awarded after the completion of a five-and-a-half-year degree programme containing four and half years of academic sessions and one year of internship with live practicals. Overall, BAMS and MBA are the top courses offered at Shree Om University.
Below mentioned are some of the Shree Om University courses and their respective eligibility and Shree Om University fees:

placements.overview:
Shree Om University has a dedicated placement support team that oversees and facilitates all placement-related activities. The university boasts a strong track record of securing excellent job opportunities for its students. In addition, students are offered internships that provide valuable hands-on industry experience.
To prepare students for the job market, the university conducts various pre-placement activities, including training in communication and writing skills, corporate guest lectures, industry visits, mock tests, and reasoning classes.
As per the official website, companies like Apollo Hospital, Kotak Mutual Fund, and Shivansh Solution have recently participated in the Shree Om University placements, offering salary packages of INR 8 LPA, INR 7 LPA, and INR 5 LPA, respectively.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely recommended for others. Solid foundation for a career in tech, value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided for our course was quite satisfactory. Our classrooms were equipped with projectors, whiteboards, and proper seating arrangements. The labs were well maintained and had high-speed internet access. Wi-Fi was available on campus and worked well.

reviews.review_heading: Choose a good college and get a good life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very nice. Our classrooms are very comfortable and very neat. The library of our college is very good. It has a peaceful environment. The hostel quality is good. The quality of the food in the mess and canteen is good. Sports and games are conducted.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable fee range with low placement level.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. It has labs, a playground to play, and coming to the hostel, the infrastructure of the hostel is also very good. In my opinion, it is worth every rupee that we are paying. But in the hostel, we don’t have any Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The facilities in my college are very good as compared to the others.
reviews.review_text: Graduation day, Farewell day, and Freshers day are all organized in the college which are fun to attend. All standards of textbooks are available along with weekly journals in the library. In the classroom, Digi Boards are available to explain the subjects in a practical manner. Sports kit can be taken from the sports room with the help of the Physical Trainer. Crec students have a page on Instagram.

reviews.review_heading: Teaching methods are very good and effective for us.
reviews.review_text: There were opportunities to learn a lot, and the hostel facilities were good. Wi-Fi and power were available 24 hours a day with generator backup. However, there was a donation requirement based on caste, which was unfair.

reviews.review_heading: C.R. Engineering College, Tirupati.
reviews.review_text: Everything is going well, and campus is awesome. The colleges have good labs with a full  area and more than 13 acres of ground. Table tennis, cricket, and basketball courts are on campus. No Wi-Fi is available; the college library is full of books and has a virtual library facility. The hostel is not good as it is on the top floor of the college. The facilities are not good, the food is not good, and no service is available. Sometimes they forget to clean hostel rooms and bathrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement preparation and placements done in 2019.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good. The library is well-stocked with all necessary books. Classrooms and bench arrangements are also good. The hostel and food are average but satisfactory. Games and sports are available during free time. There are wardens available for quick response in case of medical emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: The quality review of my college is very honest.
reviews.review_text: In the infrastructure of my college's super specialty. Labs with good equipment. Classrooms are very comfortable. In my hostel, there is good hospitality. Good dying areas and purifier water specialty. Super sports equipment and all, giving lots of time to play many games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, there is good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In hostel. One room is allotted to twenty to thirty members. The food is very average, according to the amount we are paying. They charge a hostel fee of up to INR 70,000 per month. Its a huge amount. The bathrooms are not good. There is no Wi-Fi and there are no washing machines either.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with placements, but teachers are good.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided good infrastructure. Our classrooms were good. Labs were well-equipped. A few books were available in the library. Hostel rooms were good. The quality of the food was not good. Medical facilities were not available.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for students.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has greenery all around. Our campus is free from ragging. Hostel facilities are good. The food served in the hostel is better. The restrooms are well-maintained. They provide non-vegetarian food twice a week. They also provide evening snacks to students. Our campus is very peaceful.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with this college because it has fewer faculty members.
reviews.review_text: There was no infrastructure in this college. The quality of the food in the hostel was not good. There was no canteen in our college. Medical facilities were not good. There were no sports hours for playing any games. We used to play on Sundays.

reviews.review_heading: We couldn't succeed without our effort.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not worth the money, and they provide common bathrooms in the boys' hostel. However, the girls' hostel is very good and secure. There is no Wi-Fi in the hostel. Classrooms are good with a projector, but there is no equipment in labs. All books are not available in the library.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for studies and for fun.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good, and the maintenance is not that bad. Labs are average because of their work. The Wi-Fi speed is good sometimes, and it is bad at crucial moments. There is a huge library, but we never use them. Classrooms and floors are clean.

reviews.review_heading: It provides a good future for students.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides more lab facilities and good seminar halls. Totally we have 6 computer labs, 3 chemical labs and a machinery workshop for mechanical students. Every lab is neat and in hi-tech form for further students entering the new world of technology.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Very good infrastructure and best faculty at Appa Institute of Engineering and Technology.

review_content.Placements: 89 percent of students were placed in my course. The highest package was 12 lacs per annum, and the lowest package was 1.5 lacs per annum. Altratech and AutoCAD Pro are the recruiting companies. 48 percent of students got placements. Junior engineer and assistant engineer are the top roles offered in my course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are Wi-Fi, labs, library and survey lab, AutoCAD lab, and BMT lab. Medical facilities are good, and sports and games are available. indoor games and all outdoor games are available, and the canteen is providing the best and healthiest food to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2017
reviews_list.review_title: It has a good study environment, good infrastructure and faculty, but no placements.

review_content.Placements: 60% of students got placed. 45,000 is the fee for a government seat, and 1.25 lacs is the fee for a management seat. L&T, My Home, NCC, etc., come here. No internship is provided because this college is located in a non-metro city, and metro cities are away from this location. Civil site engineer, detailing engineer, estimation engineer, etc., roles are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are good and well maintained. There are good faculty to teach students practically. The classrooms are fully furnished with AC facilities and good ventilation. The library is good with a peaceful environment for studies.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, our college is budget friendly for the students who passes the State CET.

review_content.Placements: In my course, there are 178 Students out of 180. There is a high demand for Computer Science in our district. The highest CTC offered is Rs 8 LPA, the average CTC is Rs 6 LPA and the lowest is Rs 3 LPA. Most of the students get internships and most of the companies are a startup.
review_content.Infrastructure: College provides decent facilities to their student. Facilities include facility including clean and tidy classrooms. The college books and assignment notes are also provided by the college. Infrastructure structure is also fine. There is high-speed internet in a lab. The lab is also well maintained and the library is just amazing.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Appa Institute Of Engineering and Technology.

review_content.Placements: Every year, the top MNCs conduct pool campus drives in this college. Companies like Cognizant, Infosys, NTT Data, Wipro etc. The placements are good. The college provides good placement opportunities. Even after graduation, they'll provide placement opportunities to the students.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is good. The hostel fee is low, and you won't find such a hostel in the entire city. The food quality is good. The hostel has very good facilities. There is no power cut. Wi-Fi is available. The overall food quality is good, and a variety of food is provided.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2015
reviews_list.review_title: Our college has good infrastructure and facilities, but there are no placements.

review_content.Placements: Our college doesn't have its own training and placement office. So, our college should focus more on placements by providing guidance on career planning, job searching and postgraduate studies. Our college didn't invite any core company for placements and invited only a few BPOs. None of the students from our batch got placed in any organisation.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has excellent infrastructure, and it is accessible from various parts of the city. The computer science lab is equipped with multiple terminals and internet facilities for teachers and students. The library is well-stocked, and services offered by the library are circulation, consultation and reference. Separate hostel facilities are provided for boys and girls, and hostels have adequate security and good discipline. Students are provided with all the games and sports facilities. There is also a canteen on the campus, which serves vegetarian food.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: Little bit satisfied because of faculty members but I am disappointed with the placement in 2019.

review_content.Placements: Less than 2% students were placed in our course. 7LPA was the highest, 1.5LPA was the lowest and 3.5 was the average package offered. Infosys was the top recruiting company. 100% students got internship because it was compulsory to complete internship in 8th semester, most of the students did internship in core companies like Birla, Acc ect.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was all fine, we have good classrooms, labs, library but no Wi-Fi and even we are not allowed to take mobile phones to the college. Some of the areas is under construction, they are constructing new classrooms. The hostel facilities were okay, they provide the food on time.
